scenes.narration: We all want NEAR to grow. But which way? What does the community really want right now, and how would we know?
scenes.style: Hushed and curious, close to the microphone, but moving along at a natural pace. Lean into 'which way', then let the last question hang, almost a whisper.

segments.style: Warm and sincere, a gentle wistful smile.

segments.text: But which way?
segments.style: A beat of doubt, curious, leaning in, a little rising.

segments.text: What does the community really want right now, and how would we know?

scenes.narration: The answer is already out there: in posts, issues and comments, in on-chain data, in research, in whatever Web3 is buzzing about. But reading it all by hand takes months. Sometimes a year.
scenes.style: Quiet intensity, a storyteller leaning in, brisk steady pace without dragging. A touch of wonder as the signals are listed, then stretch only the word 'months' a little and drop to a flat, weary 'Sometimes a year.'

segments.text: The answer is already out there: in posts, issues and comments, in on-chain data, in research, in whatever Web3 is buzzing about.
segments.style: The excitement of revealing a secret: a gentle discovery that brightens with every item in the list, quick and lively.

segments.text: But reading it all by hand takes months.
segments.style: A heavy, weary sigh of effort, slow, drawing out the word 'months'.

segments.text: Sometimes a year.
segments.style: Flat and tired, almost a rueful laugh at the absurdity, quiet.

scenes.narration: So we built AutoNEAR: a protocol that turns real community demand into live products on NEAR. Multi-agents keep reading the signals 24/7, a council votes on what to build, and the best idea is built and deployed, seamlessly, end to end. Humans in the loop keep the whole flow smooth.
scenes.style: A sudden lift of energy, bright and proud, goosebumps. A breath before 'AutoNEAR', announce it like a title card, then brisk and excited as the chain unfolds. The last sentence is calm and reassuring. Keep a brisk, flowing pace.
